lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sm₂Mn₆ (reduced formula SmMn₃) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: each Mn center has 12 geometric neighbors (6 Mn, 6 Sm), and each Sm center has 12 Mn neighbors, with neighbor distances from about 2.98 to 3.38 Å. The resulting geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mn and Sm coordination polyhedra.
